dependencies.name: Skill_Generator
dependencies.purpose: resolve 未命中时创建 software_use_only-<app> 附属技能

dependencies.name: camera-vision
dependencies.purpose: 取证：图像/摄像头判读（本体不自判读语义）

dependencies.name: audio-perception
dependencies.purpose: 含声音软件的听觉取证

dependencies.name: safe-mouse-automation
dependencies.purpose: invoke 阶段的真实操作通道（点击/打字/拖拽/浏览器 CDP/UIA）；本体与附属技能均不自研输入模拟，一律经其 safety_gate 前置检查、hud_overlay 会话、human_gate 停等回报后调用既有脚本（desktop_ops/app_ops/virtual_mouse/browser_cdp/batch_runner/screenshot_verify）

dependencies.name: video-viewer
dependencies.purpose: learn 阶段视频取证：probe/extract/bisect/analyze 以画面＋声音二分定位到目标时刻，再把截得的帧与音频段交 screen-vision/camera-vision/audio-perception 判读

dependencies.name: webfetch
dependencies.purpose: 网络检索官方文档，产出 source 链接

dependencies.name: task_table
dependencies.purpose: learn→resolve→invoke→reinforce 四阶段编排为任务表推进
